facts.fact: Home Affairs says its new portal on Myhomeaffairsonline for recording an intention to apply for asylum is live for a first batch of test cases, with public intake after the next weekend release.

ZAF.note: Asylum intention registration is not the national ID system.

facts.fact: Home Affairs says its portal to record asylum seekers' intention to apply, with facial biometrics and documents, is live for test cases; it confers no status and is not a formal application.
